artFamily: Buytiva Buddy, original expressive drawn ribbon shape with parcels, lists and support motifs
sourceOfTruth: Stable backend error codes override generic HTTP status; verify actual names

actionDefinitions.fix_fields: Focus first invalid field and preserve valid input
actionDefinitions.login: Navigate to login retaining safe return intent
actionDefinitions.go_home: Navigate to public or role-appropriate home
actionDefinitions.retry_safe: Retry only idempotent requests; verify payment/order status first
actionDefinitions.review_quote: Fetch and display latest versioned quote
actionDefinitions.request_invitation: Use actual backend-supported invite recovery or support
actionDefinitions.contact_support: Open authorized support conversation or approved contact method
actionDefinitions.wait: Show real retry-after or safe countdown
actionDefinitions.check_status: Query canonical order/service status, no duplicate payment
actionDefinitions.view_fund_status: Show available vs pending vs restricted funds separately

rules: Not every HTTP failure receives a full-screen illustration
Contextual error render must preserve editable data
Do not reveal sensitive security/account status when the backend masks it
Use exact stable error codes from implementation, do not infer solely HTTP class
User actions and illustrations must align on Flutter and web
Financial recoveries query existing state before any duplicate charge or transfer
Report missing error codes or endpoint gaps rather than faking behavior
